Sandbox_SignalSmoke_GrenadeSmokeSeconds_: How long the colored smoke of a smoke grenade lasts, in real seconds.
Sandbox_SignalSmoke_FlareBurnMinutes_too: How long a lit road flare burns, in in-game minutes.
Sandbox_SignalSmoke_ChemlightHours_toolt: How long an activated chemlight glows, in in-game hours. The time keeps running while it is carried.

Sandbox_SignalSmoke_ImprovisedDudChance_: Chance, in percent, that a homemade smoke bomb fizzles without smoke.
Sandbox_SignalSmoke_LootMultiplier_toolt: Multiplies the chance of finding smoke grenades, road flares and chemlights in containers. 0: none.
Sandbox_SignalSmoke_FlaresInPoliceCars: Road flares in police car trunks
Sandbox_SignalSmoke_FlaresInPoliceCars_t: Police cars can carry road flares in their trunk.
